name: Camera identification (PRNU)
corpus: synthetic photo-like scenes generated from fixed seeds (forensic.validation.run.scene)

identification.task: Was the image taken by the camera of the reference?
identification.cameras: 4 simulated sensors, PRNU std 0.005 (typical of real sensors), 384x512
identification.references: 15 flat-field images per camera, JPEG quality 95
identification.tests: 20 scenes per camera, JPEG quality 75-95; each matched to its own and to another camera's reference

known_failure_modes: Simulated sensors follow the classical multiplicative PRNU model; modern phones' multi-frame and AI processing can suppress or imitate it. Validate per phone model before relying on a match.
Strong compression, resizing and denoising weaken the fingerprint; searching crops and scales raises the chance of an accidental match.
A reference built from few or textured images is noisy; 20 or more flat, bright images is recommended.
